# Pinecone Standard Plan: Monthly Cost for 25 GB of Storage

## Summary
On Pinecone's Standard plan, 25 GB of storage costs **$50 per month**. Although the raw storage charge for 25 GB is only $8.25, the plan's $50/month minimum commitment applies because the computed usage cost falls below that floor [1].

## Pricing Structure
- The Standard plan charges **$0.33/GB/mo** for storage, listed as "Unlimited $0.33/GB/mo" in the Storage row of the pricing table [1].
- The plan carries a **minimum monthly commitment of $50/month**: "You'll be charged a minimum of $50/month. Once your usage exceeds this amount, you'll pay as you go" [1].

## Cost Calculation for 25 GB
- Raw storage cost: 25 GB × $0.33/GB/mo = **$8.25/month** [1].
- Final bill = greater of the computed cost and the minimum: max($8.25, $50) = **$50/month** [1].
- Because $8.25 < $50, the minimum commitment applies, so the effective monthly cost is **$50/month** [1].
- The $50 minimum is charged even though only $8.25 of it is attributable to storage; the remaining **$41.75** is effectively the unused portion of the minimum commitment [1].

## Cost Breakdown

| Item | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Per-GB storage rate (Standard) | $0.33/GB/mo | [1] |
| Minimum monthly commitment | $50/month | [1] |
| Raw storage cost for 25 GB | $8.25/month | [1] |
| Final monthly bill (25 GB) | $50/month | [1] |
| Unused portion of minimum | $41.75 | [1] |

## Limitations
- All figures are drawn from a single source (Pinecone's official pricing page) [1]; no independent or third-party figures were available to cross-check.
- The calculation covers storage only; other Standard plan usage (e.g., queries, indexing) is not included in the $50/month figure.

## Sources
1. [pinecone.io/pricing](https://www.pinecone.io/pricing)
